why: Today's tooling, ticket 766. N1 and N3 now use it.effect.prop, N2 uses it.prop, all with Schema inputs and unchanged assertions, coverage and fast/full counts. The shared setup sets seed 119120 once for fast-check and native Effect Arbitrary check/sample defaults. The 80-move descriptor array retains all actions, holder IDs, preconditions and the original walk. Its full 300-case run found an existing release bug: after an old script displaces 501 and ends, 502 takes the lock and 503 waits; 502 dies with child 602 running; 501 releases and unconditionally deletes 502's child guard, so 503 starts beside 602. The constant seven-move regression was written first and failed on the original product. The lead-authorized fix checks label ownership before removing either file. Displaced owners remove neither file; ordinary release and idempotence keep the same behavior.
